summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a shipped 727KB obfuscated file math_init.js at the tarball root. math_init.js is a single-line '// @bun @bun-cjs' bundle with rotated string-array indirection (decoder hc1jfK9, table n7gIxM, rotator WV8StW) and no readable logic, and it has no relationship to the dist/ React admin-layout components the package otherwise exports. The install-time execution runs an opaque payload under a runtime fetched at install time, bypassing normal Node-based review, and is grafted onto an otherwise ordinary-looking component library — the shape of a hijacked or impersonated publish under the @servicetitan scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
